6. Edit edge 5 to nor_conv_3x3. Usual sign is positive. Replacing none restores the only route from node 2 to the output, so the gain is higher.

9. Edit edge 5 to nor_conv_3x3. Usual sign is positive. Replacing nor_conv_1x1, which is already a strong op, leaves only a marginal upgrade, so the effect is lower.
10. Edit edge 3 to none. Usual sign is negative. Removing a nor_conv_3x3 loses a strong direct path, so the effect is more negative (lower) than when removing a weaker op.
